hack.root_cause: Compromised Validator Keys + Unrevoked Whitelist Access
hack.description: Lazarus Group stole $624M from Ronin Bridge by compromising 4 Sky Mavis validator keys and leveraging a 4-month-old unrevoked whitelist to obtain the 5th signature — and nobody noticed for 6 days.
